plain: To make greater in size or amount.

webster.text: To increase; to enlarge in size or extent; to swell; to make bigger; as, to augment an army, by reinforcement; rain augments a stream.

more.text: To increase; to grow larger; as, a stream augments by rain.

example.quote: The motives on the part of the State governments, to augment their prerogatives by defalcations from the federal government, will be overruled by no reciprocal predispositions in the members.
